name: resizable-15
description: Admin users table with a resizable inspector panel for the selected row.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup, } from "@workspace/ui/components/resizable" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" const users = [ { name: "Ali Imam", role: "Owner", status: "Active" }, { name: "Ben", role: "Admin", status: "Active" }, { name: "Chloe", role: "Member", status: "Invited" }, { name: "Dev", role: "Member", status: "Suspended" }, ] export default function TableWithInspector() { const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState(users[0]!) return ( Name Role {users.map((user) => ( setSelected(user)} className="cursor-pointer" > {user.name} {user.role} ))}
{selected.name .split(" ") .map((p) => p[0]) .join("")}

{selected.name}

{selected.role}

{selected.status}
) }
